name: codex-orchestration
description: Six-class taxonomy with artifact-aware and code-aware orchestration.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.10.3 uses six outcome-based classes: READ_ONLY, STANDARD_ARTIFACT, DESIGN_ARTIFACT, SMALL_TWEAK, BIG_TWEAK, and BUILD. Non-code deliverables are separated from code changes: standard artifacts use GPT-5.6 Luna / Max with a Terra / Max supervisor, design-critical artifacts use Terra / Max for implementation and supervision, small tweaks use Luna / Max with Terra / Max supervision, big tweaks use Terra / Max with a Sol / High supervisor, and every net-new code capability uses Sol / High with a Sol / Extra High supervisor. The Terra / Max orchestrator reads the current query plus bounded conversational continuity, returns the taxonomy route and a concrete reason to root, and stops. Root names every child from its actual model, starts the selected implementer first, immediately gives the read-only supervisor full context, and keeps the persistent desktop reasoning label at the generic Thinking state. Every release candidate now contains an executable repository, deployment, probe, and tunnel plan; the supervisor rejects deferred deployment discovery, and the release turn executes the approved narrow plan without unrelated rebuilds or repeated passing checks. Implementer checkpoints, release results, supervisor decisions, and final reports use readable Markdown. Seven conflict-safe companion profiles preserve the taxonomy-only orchestrator, three implementation lanes, three supervisor lanes, continuity, and fixed routing.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
